THE CONSTRUCTION

Follow the ocean-side mark.

  1. Upload, drop, or paste a map showing the white second-zone circle. Analysis starts automatically.
  2. The app detects the white boundary, finds the nested zone alignment and ocean-facing direction, then draws the diameter and marks automatically.
  3. Two perpendicular marks sit equally around the center, each one quarter of the zone radius away.
  4. The red circle is centered on the ocean-side mark. Its edge passes through the inland mark, giving it a radius of half the white zone radius.

For an unclear map, open “Fine-tune if needed” to correct its circle or coast direction. All image processing stays in your browser. Export includes the red prediction; toggle Guides to include or hide the construction.
